AccountId.documentation: The AWS AccountId used for the request.

ChannelARN.documentation: The ARN of the Kinesis data channel

ConsumerARN.documentation: The ARN of the Kinesis consumer

Endpoint.documentation: Override the endpoint used to send this request

OperationType.documentation: Internal parameter to distinguish between Control/Data plane API and accordingly generate control/data plane endpoint

Region.documentation: The AWS region used to dispatch the request.

ResourceARN.documentation: The ARN of the Kinesis resource

StreamARN.documentation: The ARN of the Kinesis stream

StreamId.documentation: The unique identifier of the Kinesis stream

UseDualStack.documentation: When true, use the dual-stack endpoint. If the configured endpoint does not support dual-stack, dispatching the request MAY return an error.

UseFIPS.documentation: When true, send this request to the FIPS-compliant regional endpoint. If the configured endpoint does not have a FIPS compliant endpoint, dispatching the request will return an error.
